Expand a compressed snapshot (.csnap) file back to original objects.

This command reads a compressed snapshot file and expands it, optionally
writing the expanded objects to a directory or outputting them.

  Expand and show object count
  zqk.test system snapshot-expand test-scenarios/my-snapshot/snapshot.csnap --verbose
  Expand and write to directory
  zqk.test system snapshot-expand snapshot.csnap --output-dir expanded/
  Expand and show first object
  zqk.test system snapshot-expand snapshot.csnap --show-object 0

Usage:
  zqk.test system snapshot-expand [flags] <csnap-file>

Flags:
      --output-dir string   Directory to write expanded objects (default: stdout)
      --show-object int     Show specific object by index (0-based) (default -1)
      --verify-only         Only verify the snapshot without expanding

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
